info.name: World News Extract News Top News API

params.name: source-country
params.description: The ISO 3166 country code for which to get top news (e.g. "us").

params.name: language
params.description: The ISO 6391 language code of the top news (e.g. "en").

params.name: date
params.description: The date for which to get top news (yyyy-MM-dd); defaults to today.

params.name: headlines-only
params.description: Whether to return only the headlines (true) or full article data (false).

items.docs: Retrieve the top news for a country and language on a given day, clustered so that stories covered by more outlets rank higher.
